key.name: mark-done
key.summary: Mark the current (▶) step done; once every step is answered, the same chord sends

key.name: undo-done
key.summary: Undo the last answered step (done or failed)

key.name: attach-snip
key.summary: Attach the current clipboard snip to the current (▶) step

key.name: edit-note
key.summary: Type a reply under the current (▶) step (Enter saves, Esc cancels)

key.name: submit-answer
key.summary: Submit the reply (checked steps + attached snips)

key.name: dismiss-request
key.summary: Decline the request (the agent is told)

key.name: toggle-glossary
key.summary: Hide/show the hotkey glossary in the overlay

key.name: glossary-visible
key.summary: Whether the overlay shows the full hotkey glossary (the NOW line is always shown)
